items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And then I met . . . I’m having to go back to Chicago . . . Sidney Catlett and people like that.

ctx.x: Still, in a way I guess I was still more involved with the people that Jimmy would have. And then I met . . . I’m having to go back to Chicago . . . Sidney Catlett and people like that. Anyway, he was in Boston at the time, and he had a rent party that we all went to.
Yeah, I’d like to see a few of those right now. [laughs]
